channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma9

- '3.10'

about.description:
Use airflow to author workflows as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs)
of tasks. The airflow scheduler executes your tasks on an array of
workers while following the specified dependencies. Rich command
line utilities make performing complex surgeries on DAGs a snap.
The rich user interface makes it easy to visualize pipelines
running in production, monitor progress, and troubleshoot issues
when needed.

When workflows are defined as code, they become more maintainable,
versionable, testable, and collaborative.

name: airflow
raw_meta_yaml:
# python must be less than this version
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: airflow
  pypi_name: apache-airflow
  version: "3.2.2"
  task_sdk_version: "1.2.2"  # manually update with each airflow release
  python_over: "3.15"

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ pypi_name[0] }}/${{ pypi_name }}/apache_airflow-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 5625a596be4a3b96d93d401412bd41a28181ff32ef1219af277ab1d42453b8d6
    target_directory: airflow
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/a/apache-airflow-core/apache_airflow_core-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 5473699fca8b9b64680d24c6fd2adbf1ad1168facc849cdfaec0f9715d76d7a1
    target_directory: airflow-core
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/a/apache-airflow-task-sdk/apache_airflow_task_sdk-${{ task_sdk_version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 3c8b3c4c86fe97dad5779004218c351cfd85f3dfc5a3f68b86127f266f9b286a
    target_directory: airflow-task-sdk

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: apache-airflow-task-sdk
      version: ${{ task_sdk_version }}
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - cd "${SRC_DIR}/airflow-task-sdk"
        - $PYTHON -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling ==1.29.0
        - packaging ==26.2
        - pathspec ==1.1.1
        - pluggy ==1.6.0
        - tomli ==2.4.1
        - trove-classifiers ==2026.5.20.19
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}
        - apache-airflow-core ==${{ version }}
        # tighter constraint for python >=3.14
        - asgiref >=3.11.1
        - attrs >=24.2.0,!=25.2.0
        - babel >=2.17.0
        - fsspec >=2023.10.0
        - httpx >=0.27.0
        - jinja2 >=3.1.5
        - methodtools >=0.4.7
        - msgspec >=0.19.0
        - python-dateutil >=2.7.0
        - psutil >=6.1.0
        - structlog >=25.4.0
        - greenback >=1.2.1
        - tenacity >=8.3.0
        - pendulum >=3.1.0
        - colorlog >=6.8.2
        - pydantic >2.11.0
        - pygtrie >=2.5.0
    # tests section intentionally omitted because of circular dependencies
    about:
      summary: Python Task SDK for Apache Airflow DAG Authors
      license: Apache-2.0
      license_file: airflow-task-sdk/LICENSE
      homepage: https://github.com/apache/airflow
      repository: https://github.com/apache/airflow
      documentation: https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/task-sdk/README.md
  - package:
      name: apache-airflow-core
    build:
      noarch: python
      python:
        entry_points:
          - airflow = airflow.__main__:main
      script:
        - cd "${SRC_DIR}/airflow-core"
        - $PYTHON -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - gitdb ==4.0.12
        - gitpython ==3.1.50
        - hatchling ==1.29.0
        - packaging ==26.2
        - pathspec ==1.1.1
        - pluggy ==1.6.0
        - smmap ==5.0.3
        - tomli ==2.4.1
        - trove-classifiers ==2026.5.20.19
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}
        - apache-airflow-task-sdk ==${{ task_sdk_version }}
        - a2wsgi >=1.10.8
        - cachetools >=6.0.0
        - aiosqlite >=0.20.0,<0.22.0
        - alembic >=1.13.1,<2.0
        - argcomplete >=1.10
        # tighter constraint for python >=3.14
        - asgiref >=3.11.1
        - attrs >=22.1.0,!=25.2.0
        - cadwyn >=6.1.1
        - colorlog >=6.8.2
        - cron-descriptor >=1.2.24
        - croniter >=2.0.2
        - cryptography >=44.0.3
        - deprecated >=1.2.13
        - dill >=0.2.2
        - fastapi >=0.129.0
        - uvicorn >=0.37.0
        - starlette >=1.0.1
        - httpx >=0.25.0
        - importlib-metadata >=7.0
        - itsdangerous >=2.0
        - jinja2 >=3.1.5
        - jsonschema >=4.19.1
        - lazy-object-proxy >=1.2.0
        # tighter constraint for python >=3.14
        - libcst >=1.8.6
        - linkify-it-py >=2.0.0
        - lockfile >=0.12.2
        - methodtools >=0.4.7
        - natsort >=8.4.0
        - opentelemetry-api >=1.27.0
        - opentelemetry-exporter-otlp >=1.27.0
        - packaging >=25.0
        - pathspec >=0.9.0
        - pendulum >=3.1.0
        - pluggy >=1.5.0
        - psutil >=5.8.0
        - pydantic >=2.11.0
        - pygments >=2.0.1,!=2.19.0
        - pyjwt >=2.11.0
        - python-daemon >=3.0.0
        - python-dateutil >=2.7.0
        - python-slugify >=5.0
        - requests >=2.32.0,<3
        - rich-argparse >=1.0.0
        - rich >=13.6.0
        - setproctitle >=1.3.3
        - sqlalchemy >=2.0.48
        - greenlet !=0.4.17
        - svcs >=25.1.0
        - tabulate >=0.9.0
        - tenacity >=8.3.0
        - termcolor >=3.0.0
        - typing-extensions >=4.14.1
        - universal-pathlib >=0.3.8
        - uuid6 >=2024.7.10
        - apache-airflow-providers-common-compat >=1.7.4
        - apache-airflow-providers-common-io >=1.6.3
        - apache-airflow-providers-common-sql >=1.28.1
        - apache-airflow-providers-smtp >=2.3.1
        - apache-airflow-providers-standard >=1.9.0
        - msgspec >=0.19.0
        - pygtrie >=2.5.0
        - structlog >=25.4.0
        - pyyaml>=6.0.3
        - pluggy>=1.5.0
    # tests section intentionally omitted because of circular dependencies
    about:
      summary: Core packages for Apache Airflow, schedule and API server
      license: MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause AND Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - airflow-core/LICENSE
        - airflow-core/NOTICE
      homepage: http://airflow.apache.org
      repository: https://github.com/apache/airflow
      documentation: http://pythonhosted.org/airflow/profiling.html
  - package:
      name: apache-airflow-core-with-all
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}
        - apache-airflow-core == ${{ version }}
        # graphviz extra
        - python-graphviz >=0.20

        # kerberos extra
        - pykerberos >=1.1.13
        - requests-kerberos >=0.14.0
        - thrift_sasl >=0.4.2

        # otel extra
        - opentelemetry-exporter-prometheus >=0.51b0

        # sentry extra
        - sentry-sdk >=2.30.0
        - flask >=0.11
        - blinker >=1.1
        - markupsafe

        # statsd extra
        - statsd >=3.3.0
    # tests section intentionally omitted because of circular dependencies
    about:
      summary: Core packages for Apache Airflow, schedule and API server
      license: MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause AND Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - airflow-core/LICENSE
        - airflow-core/NOTICE
      homepage: http://airflow.apache.org
      repository: https://github.com/apache/airflow
      documentation: http://pythonhosted.org/airflow/profiling.html
  - package:
      name: apache-airflow
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - cd "${SRC_DIR}/airflow"
        - $PYTHON -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling ==1.29.0
        - packaging ==26.2
        - pathspec ==1.1.1
        - pluggy ==1.5.0
        # for all python (not just py < 3.11) so we can stay noarch: python
        - tomli ==2.4.1
        - trove-classifiers ==2026.5.20.19
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}
        - apache-airflow-task-sdk ==${{ task_sdk_version }}
        - apache-airflow-core == ${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - airflow
          pip_check: true
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
      - requirements:
          run:
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        script:
          - airflow --help
          - airflow db --help
          - airflow db check
  # alternative name for the package
  - package:
      name: airflow
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        # needed to make sure each python version gets a unique build string
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}
        - apache-airflow ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - airflow
            - airflow.sdk
          pip_check: true
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
  - package:
      name: airflow-with-all-core
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}
        - apache-airflow ==${{ version }}
        - apache-airflow-core-with-all
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - airflow
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
      - requirements:
          run:
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
            - pip
        script:
          - pip check
  - package:
      name: airflow-with-all
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        # Some packages require pandas >=2.2.3 and others require older.
        # Since we can't have it both ways, we're leaving out packages
        # requiring the older pandas for now.
        #
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}
        - apache-airflow ==${{ version }}
        - apache-airflow-core-with-all
